hero.title: A Vite starter without the framework tax
hero.subtitle: Plain JavaScript templating, Tailwind CSS v4, Sass, i18next and Vitest — wired together and nothing more.

build.title: Vite build
build.body: Hashed assets sorted by type, a single vendor chunk, and a bundle report behind npm run analyze.

styles.title: Tailwind CSS v4 + Sass
styles.body: The Tailwind Vite plugin handles utilities and prefixing; Sass stays for the handful of global rules.

i18n.title: i18next
i18n.body: Translations load over HTTP per language, with detection cached in localStorage.

quality.title: Quality gates
quality.body: ESLint, Prettier, type-checked JSDoc and Vitest run on every commit and in CI.

counter.hint: One delegated listener drives every interaction on the page.
